title: Pooling Mobility Obscures Epidemic Invasion Routes
summary: Epidemic models often pool air travel, commuting, and other mobility layers into a single weighted network. Pooling keeps the total imported infections into a region but discards the transport mode and route that delivered them, the information a mode-specific intervention needs. We make this precise for directed multilayer flows with heavy-tailed variation. Pooling acts as an asymmetric filter.
